name: Steel.dev

modes.label: Browser session, Launch rate ($0.10/browser-hour)
modes.note: Browser hours billed by the minute, rounded up (so each session bills >= 1 min). Rate applies only on the Launch plan ($0 fee). Launch caps: 10 concurrent sessions, 15-min max session, 60 req/min. Browser vCPU/RAM not published (size vcpu/ram null). Billing runs from create until release()/timeout; default timeout 5 min; without inactivityTimeout a stalled client stays billed until the timeout. Basis (checked 2026-09-28): wall-clock browser time, no CPU/RAM metering, so alloc: 'Browser hours are billed by the minute, rounded up' (https://docs.steel.dev/overview/pricinglimits). Idle: opt-in inactivityTimeout, e.g. 'Release the session after 1 minute with no CDP or input activity' (off by default), else the 5-min default timeout (https://docs.steel.dev/overview/sessions-api/session-lifecycle).

modes.label: Browser session, Scale rate ($0.08/browser-hour)
modes.commit_note: Rate only available with the Scale plan ($250/month + usage, $100 monthly usage credit).
modes.note: Billed per minute, rounded up. Scale caps: 100 concurrent, 1-hour max session (long jobs must re-create sessions and re-inject state via Profiles/sessionContext), 600 req/min. Proxy $6/GB, CAPTCHA $1/1k, Browser Tools $5/1k, dedicated IP $5/IP/month. Basis: wall-clock browser-minutes (alloc); idle release via opt-in inactivityTimeout, same as Launch.

modes.label: Enterprise (custom rates, reserved browser pools, stealth browser)
modes.commit_note: Custom contract; rates, credits and limits unpublished.
modes.note: 1,000+ concurrent, sessions up to 24 h, Stealth Browser and reserved browser pools included. Browser-hour, proxy and CAPTCHA rates all 'Custom'. Basis: browser-hours (alloc), rates custom.

storage.note: Profiles (persisted cookies/auth/extensions) are free but capped at 300 MB per profile and auto-deleted after 30 days unused. No per-GB storage price published.

plans.name: Launch
plans.note: $30 one-time usage credit valid 90 days (see free.one_time_credit). Up to 3 seats. 60 req/min, 7-day data retention. Steel proxies and CAPTCHA solving require a $10 paid-balance deposit (counts toward usage, free credits don't count). Auto top-up available. Pairs with mode 'launch'.

plans.name: Scale
plans.note: $250/month + usage; includes $100 usage credit per month applied to browser hours, proxy GB, CAPTCHA and Browser Tools. Unlimited seats, 600 req/min, 14-day retention, dedicated Slack, Enterprise SSO, HIPAA-ready BAA, dedicated IPs $5/IP/month (up to 25 self-serve). Pairs with mode 'scale'.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom + usage. 1,000+ concurrent sessions (concurrency null = custom). Stealth Browser, reserved browser pools, SLAs, 911 email.

plans.name: Legacy Starter / Developer / Startup
plans.note: Pre-2026-06-26 plans kept by existing customers only ('no forced migration'). Official pages no longer publish their prices. THIRD-PARTY ONLY: Starter $29/mo, Developer $99/mo, Startup $499/mo (costbench.com, verified 2026-06-14); included hours 290 / 1,238 / 9,980 per a search-engine summary, unverified. Not purchasable by new users.

features.ip_note: Datacenter IPs by default; managed residential proxies $10/GB (Launch) / $6/GB (Scale) on paid plans; BYO datacenter/residential/mobile proxy on all plans at no extra cost; CAPTCHA solving on paid plans; dedicated "Stealth Browser" is Enterprise-only.

perf_source: No benchmark row: provider is not in ComputeSDK results or the HPC run (as of 2026-09-28). See research/perf-map.json.

knobs.label: Billed session time vs useful work (idle until release/timeout)
knobs.why: Sessions bill per minute from create until release() or timeout (default 5 min). Without inactivityTimeout a stalled client keeps the browser billed until the hard timeout.

knobs.label: Workload egress routed through Steel proxies (Launch)
knobs.why: Only Steel-managed proxy bandwidth is billed (bidirectional, incl. TLS handshakes and headers); default datacenter IP and BYO proxies are free. Launch needs a $10 paid deposit to use proxies. Source: docs.steel.dev/overview/pricinglimits (verified 2026-09-28).

knobs.label: Workload egress routed through Steel proxies (Scale)
knobs.why: Scale proxy bandwidth is $6/GB; the $100 monthly Scale credit also covers proxy GB. Source: docs.steel.dev/overview/pricinglimits (verified 2026-09-28).

caveats: Browser-hour priced product: no published vCPU/RAM per session (sizes vcpu/ram null); the engine cannot size-match, treat 1 session = 1 browser instance.
Plan and rate are coupled: $0.10/h only on Launch, $0.08/h only on Scale. Each mode carries 'requires_plan' so the engine never combines the Scale rate with the Launch plan.

Proxy bandwidth is modelled by knobs proxy_launch ($10/GB) / proxy_scale ($6/GB) with effect 'egress_gib_rate', each restricted to its plan's mode; default 0 = no Steel proxy. network.egress_gib = 0 because non-proxy traffic is not metered per docs.
Launch max session 15 min and Scale 1 h: long agent runs must be split into many sessions (state carried via Profiles API / sessionContext). Enterprise needed for sessions up to 24 h.
CAPTCHA solves $3/1k (Launch, needs $10 deposit) / $1/1k (Scale); Browser Tools /scrape /screenshot /pdf $5/1k; not modelled in the card.
Dedicated static egress IPs: $5/IP/month on Scale (up to 25 self-serve); their traffic is still metered as proxy bandwidth. Not a public inbound IPv4, so network.ipv4_* left null/false.
Browsers run in one region (us-east); proxy geolocation changes the visible IP location only.
Host OS / isolation technology undocumented (isolation 'container' is an assumption for the card enum; features.linux null).
Legacy Starter/Developer/Startup plan prices are third-party only (costbench.com); official pages do not publish them.
Self-hosting the open-source steel-browser Docker image is free (you pay your own compute); not modelled as a mode.
No SOC 2 statement found; HIPAA-ready BAA on Scale/Enterprise. No latency benchmark available (vendor claims <1 s average session start).

ENGINE LIMITATION (verifier 2026-09-28): sizes have vcpu/ram_gib null (unpublished), and engine.js hourly() filters sizes with s.vcpu >= W.vcpu, which is false for null, so this card is currently never priced ('no preset'). Needs an engine rule for unsized browser-session presets; numbers were not invented to work around it.

fleet.verification: Launch must add $10 paid balance to enable CAPTCHA solving or Steel proxies; free credits do not qualify. Deposit funds usage, not a fee.
fleet.notes: Current plans replace legacy Starter/Developer/Startup for new accounts. 10 fits Launch, 50 Scale, 300/1,000 Enterprise. Anti-bot/proxy verification is distinct from concurrency.
